capabilities: Open all media files in a note in a full-screen browser
Open the media browser by clicking on an image
Create gallery blocks that show media in a grid
Add images to galleries by drag and drop
Configure gallery size, pagination, titles and filters
extras: Documentation is also available in Japanese and Chinese per the README header. Settings can allow deleting media files, so misuse could remove images from the vault.
problem: Obsidian lacks a built-in way to browse all media in a note full-screen or to display multiple media files as a grid gallery.
summary: Media viewer plugin that opens a note's images and videos in a full-screen browser and renders gallery grid blocks.
